_fixture_envelope.description: Operator's F&F location is bound to America/Vancouver (Pacific). The 7shifts company carries a Toronto location with location.timezone='America/Toronto'. Punch UTC instants are unambiguous; the resolver must select America/Vancouver (the F&F location-bound IANA) when computing business_date for canonical facts, NOT the vendor's nested location.timezone value.
_fixture_envelope.expected_behavior: Adapter persists UTC instants verbatim. Downstream `iana_timezone_converter.toBusinessDate` resolves business_date against the F&F location's IANA (America/Vancouver) so the punch's business_date = 2026-04-15 (UTC 02:30 = Pacific 19:30 prior day; UTC 07:30 = Pacific 00:30 next day → wraps midnight in Vancouver). Adapter does NOT branch on the vendor's location.timezone field.
